creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Case.markers (case.go:13) is set in newCase and read nowhere. Case.dirty
(case.go:36) is written in runCase and read nowhere.

Both cost a reader the time it takes to work out whether they matter. Delete them,
and if dirty was reaching for something - a summary of which files changed under
update, say - that belongs in a card of its own rather than a field waiting to be
noticed.
title: Remove dead fields Case.markers and Case.dirty
